sonnet.problem: Both true/false cards (5 and 12) have False as the right answer. The stop has two true/false cards but none whose right answer is True.
sonnet.rule: In a stop with 2 or more, at least one answer is True and at least one is False, in no set pattern.

sonnet.problem: The card retells Zechariah saying no (4:5) and then the angel's word to Zerubbabel (4:6), but it cites only 4:6.
sonnet.rule: Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
